results.description: Observable results this ExpectedResult checks for, one element per observable result. Used for test-case generation; description is a human-facing summary only.

additional_steps.description: Extra operations to perform before checking these results, e.g. reloading the page to confirm persistence. Contract: within a Condition's expected/ directory, filename order (001, 002, ...) is the execution order of these phases; the first file (by filename) may omit this field or leave it an empty array, but every later file must declare at least one non-empty step (enforced by `markharness validate`'s cross-reference check, not expressible in this per-file schema alone).

implementation_note.description: Implementation rationale. Not used for generation.

generated_by.description: How this ExpectedResult's content was produced. Omitted means unknown, not 'manual'.

verified_by.description: Human review gate. Omitting the whole field means not (yet) reviewed.
